description:
Seo Woon-ho has been selflessly living his life to pay off his father's debt.

His first love, Dae Jin-woo, appears in front of him... and somehow he has become a creditor of the debt!

Jin-woo presses him to do his bidding, just as he did 12 years ago. However, Uno has not healed from the emotional trauma of those days...

“Are you asking me to give up my body to you?
You know exactly what I mean.

What will happen to their relationship that will be repeated again...?
Will Uno be able to escape from him without getting hurt? 

[Original Novel](https://ridibooks.com/books/3302003207)  
[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/5001000053)
